$description: ComponentLab V2 Component Registry — the authoritative source for component axes, legal combinations, slots and generation boundaries (《Component 层 Token 构建规范》). Recipes (source/component-recipes/) hold design values; generated/component.json is the downstream product. This file and the recipes are physically separate, independently versioned files.

open.description: Select 弹层展开条件，可与 focused 等视觉 State 并存

propertyAliases.$description: 历史属性名到规范属性词汇的迁移别名（按 slot 定位）：radius -> border-radius；border/width -> border-width；container/gap -> content/gap。由编译器在解析时统一归一化，输出只用规范属性名。

input.unifiedIdentity: Input 与 LineEdit 统一为公共 input 家族；line-edit 不再作为独立公共 Token 家族

constraints.reason: disabled/loading 时 popup 必须关闭且不得重新打开

table.$description: Composite data-table contract. Visual axes are limited to density and striping; column, cell, editor and runtime semantics are kept in the separate Component Contract.

date-time-input.qtClass: commonWidget::Z_DateTimeInput (custom composite; Qt temporal adapters inside)

otherFamilies.$description: 其余组件家族（tool-button、pagination、tooltip、badge、tag、progress-bar、slider、scroll-bar、dial、stepper、menu-bar、menu-bar-item、desktop-bottom-navigation、dialog-button-group、spin-box、double-spin-box、date-picker、time-picker、date-time-picker、label、lcd-number、text-browser、data-display、container、divider、frame、chip、selection-control、message、navigation-bar 等）按各自 Recipe 登记的 state/size/variant 轴与 Slot 生成；Registry 登记其 states 与 slots（见各家族条目）。未在此登记轴值的家族在 Recipe 中不得引入新轴。
